guide.what: European Commission Economic Sentiment Indicator for the euro area (long-term average 100, standard deviation 10).
read: Above 100 is above average. Peaks have usually been 115+; sharp falls of 2-3 standard deviations have tended to mark troughs.
Look at the sector pieces (industry, services, consumers, retail, construction) and the big countries.
The STOXX 600 and euro-area GDP have risen together in about 63% of quarters.
